title: One of the best apps in its category
body:
I've tried Rituals, Habit Factor and Daily Deeds and I find Way of Life to best the best overall. Great design. Good summarization of the data and backing up. 
Rituals was my favorite until the day I opened the app and it had lost all my content. So far Way of Life has been solid and a great motivation!!
If it only could export CSV and maybe have numeric fields that'd make it beat all other apps feature-wise!
author: erocarrera

title: More specific
body:
The app is nice alright, but possibility to be more specific would really improve it a lot! Like being able to indicate how much time or what distance you've been running, how much cigarettes, or how much coffee.... And compare that with your objective. Then you can really see your improvements.   
Just a yes/no kind of focus is a bit too limited/vague.
